messages:
maria: heads up — onboarding job for `llama-3-small` failing in staging. saw a lint error and then an OOM when loading quantized weights. also some decode garbage in evals. anyone picked this up?
jon: link to logs? stack trace?
maria: https://ci.redwood.local/job/5423 (paste below)
ci-bot: build #5423 FAILED — runtime error during model_load (OOM).
--- log snippet ---
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1.2 GiB for tensor 'kv_cache'
Config: model.yaml -> model_type: causal, quant: q4_0, max_seq_len: 8192, tokenizer: ./tokenizer.json, weights: s3://redwood-models/llama-3/weights-q4_0/
----------------

deepak: two quick bets: 1) tokenizer.json might be from an older vocab schema (we changed special token ids last week) 2) quant q4_0 can spike mem on init for long context models — try q4_1 fallback.
alex: did the onboarding script pick the right weights path? last week we had a symlink change -> some jobs still point to /weights/ vs /weights-v2/
maria: weights path in job config is `s3://redwood-models/llama-3/weights-q4_0/` — but arnav's publish moved files to `weights-v2` yesterday. trying to re-run with corrected path.
jon: also check `use_kv_shards` flag in model.yaml — the linter complained unknown field. maybe the new runtime expects `kv_sharding: true` instead.
tara: pinging @sre to bump node shm for the staging pool while you debug — OOM might be exacerbated by other pods.
sre-bot: incident (staging-memory) created. assigned to @sre-oncall.
jon: quick local repro:
```bash
# run minimal loader
tools/model-load --config examples/llama3-staging.yaml --lazy-init
```
use `--lazy-init` to observe peak mem vs eager.

maria: tried lazy-init + q4_1 and tokenizer from repo — still seeing decode errors on a handful of eval prompts: odd tokens like "<unk>��" in middle.
deepak: that looks like tokenizer mismatch (byte vs unicode mapping). can you paste top of tokenizer.json? specifically `added_tokens` and `encoder` version line.
maria: paste: { "version": "v1.2", "added_tokens": ["<s>","</s>"] , ... }
deepak: our current runtime expects `v1.3` (we added byte-level normalizer) — the loader will silently map bytes and produce replacement chars. need to upgrade tokenizer or use `tokenizer_compat: v1.2` shim.
alex: I can push a small shim that maps ids for onboarding jobs. PR ready in my fork, will link.
jon: also add a config lint rule to fail-on-unknown-field so `use_kv_shards` vs `kv_sharding` doesn't slip through. open an issue?
tara: created GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1982 for linter strictness.
ci-bot: build #5424 triggered (maria) — model-load with corrected s3 path.
maria: build 5424 failed but different error: checksum mismatch when fetching weights (E_TAG_MISMATCH).
deepak: checksum mismatch — might be partial upload; reupload or validate with `aws s3 cp --no-progress` then `sha256sum`.
alex: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/895 adds tokenizer shim and a config-lint rule. small change, can land if tests green.
maria: re-uploaded weights to `weights-v2` and updated job. re-running.
sre-bot: staging node pool autoscaler adjusted, restarted failed pods.
jon: after switching to q4_1 + shim + correct weights path, load completes in ~45s and no OOM. decode issues resolved on 25/25 eval prompts.
maria: great — I'll merge the PR and update onboarding template to point to `weights-v2` and set `tokenizer_compat: v1.2` until all tokenizers migrate.
tara: can we add a post-onboard check so CI asserts tokenizer.version == runtime.expected_version? filed #1983.
maria: added a minimal job to the onboarding workflow to run `tools/tokenizer-check --expected v1.3` and `tools/model-lint` before launching.
alex: tiny note — we should document quant fallback order (q4_1 -> q4_0 -> fp16) in the onboarding README. I'll add that.
maria: thanks all. follow-ups: merge PR 895, land linter change, update onboarding job templates, and mark incident resolved once staging is green.
ci-bot: build #5430 SUCCESS (post-fix).
jon: :thumbsup: closing loop.
